title: Challenges in Barren Plateau Mitigation with Dynamic Parameterized Quantum Circuits
summary: Variational quantum algorithms (VQAs) are a promising paradigm for quantum advantage, yet their trainability is severely hampered by barren plateaus (BPs). Several recent works have proposed dynamic parameterized quantum circuits (DPQCs), which interleave unitary layers with parameterized CPTP maps, such as engineered dissipation, feedforward gadgets, and periodic resets, as a possible strategy for mitigating BPs.
